meta.name: shadcn
meta.description: Manages shadcn components and projects — adding, searching, fixing, debugging, styling, and composing UI, including chat interfaces. Provides project context, component docs, and usage examples. Applies when working with shadcn/ui, component registries, presets, --preset codes, or any project with a components.json file. Also triggers for "shadcn init", "create an app with --preset", or "switch to --preset".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加、修复、调整界面组件,快速搭建标准化的前端页面。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在搭建网页界面,需要反复添加和调整现成的界面组件。
copy.tagline_en: Add, fix, and style UI components to streamline building frontend pages.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build web interfaces and want to easily manage and adjust UI components.

howto.what: 它会用项目所用的包管理器运行 shadcn 命令行,帮你添加、查找、检查并修复 shadcn/ui 组件,按项目配置改写导入路径、套用预设,并按内置规则写组件代码。
howto.when: 当你提到 shadcn/ui、组件注册表或 --preset,或项目里存在 components.json 时由它接管;做 shadcn init 之类初始化时也适用。

say.text: 帮我用 shadcn 加一个登录区块
say.note: 它会先问你要用哪个注册表

say.text: 检查一下我刚加的这个 select 组件
say.note: 它会读文件并按内置规则逐条核对

say.text: 把这个预设码应用到我当前项目
say.note: 它用 shadcn apply 套用该预设

howto.what_en: It runs the shadcn CLI with your project's package manager to add, search, inspect and fix shadcn/ui components, adjust imports and presets to your project config, and follow its built-in rules when writing component code.
howto.when_en: It applies when you mention shadcn/ui, component registries or --preset, or when the project has a components.json file; also for shadcn init.

say_en.text: Add a login block with shadcn
Check the select component I just added
say_en.note: Reads the files against its rules

say_en.text: Apply a preset code to this project
say_en.note: Runs shadcn apply with that code
